Avatar checks protect against malformed/untrusted local metadata; not kernel isolation against same-privilege concurrent filesystem replacement. Artwork must now live under the documented original/enhanced input directory; help and design documentation updated.

Interpolation protects reruns via refusal and durable progress marker. It still modifies assets in place; not an atomic whole-pack transaction or automatic rollback. Restore all original atlas/animation/manifest before retry, not merely delete marker. Total timing preserved, not a claim that pixel interpolation or local motion quality is verified.
Proof authentication protects cross-origin browser writes; a hostile local process able to read fixture tokens or edit operator receipt files is outside this boundary. No token retained in evidence.
